run_english_cleaners: run the english_cleaners function to normalize English text with number and abbreviation expansion
run_transliteration_cleaners: run the transliteration_cleaners function to transliterate non-English text to ASCII and normalize whitespace
run_basic_cleaners: run the basic_cleaners function to lowercase text and collapse whitespace without transliteration
test_expand_abbreviations: test the expand_abbreviations function to replace abbreviations like Mr. and Dr. with full words
run_convert_to_ascii: run the convert_to_ascii function to transliterate Unicode text to ASCII using Unidecode
